result:
I would make cruelty impossible to hide from oneself: every act of harm would be experienced, fully and unmistakably, by the person who caused it.

Not as punishment. As truth.

The world would change because exploitation, indifference, and violence depend on distance. Remove that distance, and people would be forced to live inside the real consequences of their choices.
